data.title: Central Park at City Walk
data.about:
Never settle for anything less than you deserve. Here at Central Park at City Walk, you will experience the beauty of life at its finest with fresh air, picturesque views, lush green landscapes, morning park runs, and exclusive amenities for an active and posh lifestyle. A tranquil community featuring countryside ambiance located in Dubai’s bustling metropolis, this premier destination offers everything you need from A to Z.

A Countryside in the Heart of the Desert Metropolis
Experience the healing power of nature amidst the hustle and bustle of the city by living the life you have always dreamed of. Make good weather, breathtaking landscapes, fresh air, colorful blossoms, and a healthy lifestyle your everyday routine at Central Park Apartments in Dubai. Plus, take time to pause on life by indulging in the finest café, restaurants, high-end retail stores, and supreme entertainment at your doorsteps.

Ideal Neighbourhood for Your Dream Lifestyle
Achieve your dream of authentic park living while enjoying the urban vibes of City Walk. A world-class lifestyle destination for those who want to get the best of both worlds, this family-friendly neighbourhood by Meraas boast a unique collection of residences that will suit your taste and preferences.

Green Landscapes and Blue Skies All Year Round
Conceptualized and designed with the future in mind, Central Park by Meraas offers a mix of sleek, modern, and spacious apartments in a community featuring scenic views of the azure sky and lush gardens all year round.

location_tile.title: Connected by a well-established road network
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Spend life’s greatest moments with your loved ones in a place where the countryside’s natural beauty and the city’s urban spirit meet. Here at Central Park by Meraas, experience connectivity and accessibility at its finest.

  • Strategically located between Jumeirah Street and Sheikh Zayed Road
  • Upscale neighbourhood inside City Walk
  • Only 5 minutes from Dubai Arena
  • Only 10 minutes from Jumeirah Beach
  • Only 10 minutes from Dubai International Airport
  • Only 15 minutes to the luxurious Burj Al Arab
  • Only 16 minutes to the iconic La Mer Beach
  • Only 17 minutes to the renowned Palm Jumeirah
  • Only 20 minutes to the panoramic Dubai Marina
  • Only 50 minutes to the global aviation hub, Al Maktoum International Airport
